mcp.title: MCP
mcp.subtitle: Connect local tools and remote services with stdio or Streamable HTTP.
mcp.reloadHint: Saving updates disk only. Run /mcp reload in an existing conversation to apply changes, or restart the app. Project entries replace global entries by name.
mcp.saved: Saved. Run /mcp reload in the conversation to apply changes.
mcp.environmentHint: Use ${ENV_VAR} in headers, environment variables or URLs. Values resolve only when connecting. Legacy HTTP+SSE is not supported.
mcp.empty: No servers in this file. Add a server or paste your configuration into mcp.json.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.nameConflict: Choose a non-empty, unique server name.
mcp.advancedHint: Edit headers, env, cwd and other advanced fields in the mcp.json tab. Existing fields are preserved.
mcp.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from this configuration? Save to apply the removal.

archived.title: Archived Tasks
archived.subtitle: Review archived tasks, restore them to the task list, or permanently delete local session files.
archived.listSubtitle: Archiving hides a task from the main list. Deleting removes the underlying session file.
archived.deleteQuestion: Permanently delete "{{name}}"? This removes the local session file and cannot be undone.
archived.deleteAllQuestion: Permanently delete all {{count}} archived tasks? This removes the local session files and cannot be undone.
archived.deleteAllError: Some archived tasks could not be deleted: {{message}}

display.title: Display & Sound
display.subtitle: Tune visuals and audio alerts to your preferences.
display.sectionSubtitle: Adjust how the window renders backgrounds and effects.

messageFilePath.title: Show file path in messages
messageFilePath.subtitle: Display the parent path next to file links in messages.

splitPanes.title: Split chat and diff center panes
splitPanes.subtitle: Show chat and diff side by side instead of swapping between them.

threadTitles.title: Auto-generate new thread titles
threadTitles.subtitle: Generate a short title from your first message (uses extra tokens).

transparency.title: Reduce transparency
transparency.subtitle: Use solid surfaces instead of glass.

uiFont.label: UI font family
uiFont.help: Applies to all UI text. Leave empty to use the default system font stack.

codeFont.label: Code font family
codeFont.help: Applies to git diffs and other mono-spaced readouts.

codeFontSize.label: Code font size
codeFontSize.help: Adjusts code and diff text size.

chat.sectionSubtitle: Control how much conversation history is retained per thread.

unlimited.title: Unlimited chat history
unlimited.subtitle: Keep full thread history in memory (may impact performance).

chat.scrollbackHelp: Higher values keep more history but may increase memory usage. Use “Sync from server” on a thread to re-fetch older messages.
chat.rangeHelp: Range: {{min}}–{{max}}. Counts messages, tool calls, and other conversation items.

notificationSounds.title: Notification sounds
notificationSounds.subtitle: Play a sound when a long-running agent finishes while the window is unfocused.

systemNotifications.title: System notifications
systemNotifications.subtitle: Show a system notification when a long-running agent finishes while the window is unfocused.

subagentNotifications.title: Sub-agent notifications
subagentNotifications.subtitle: Include spawned sub-agent threads in system notifications.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Group related workspaces and reorder projects within each group.

groups.title: Groups
groups.subtitle: Create group labels for related repositories.
groups.deleteMove: Projects in this group will move to “{{group}}”.

projectList.title: Projects
projectList.subtitle: Assign projects to groups and adjust their order.

openApps.title: Open in
openApps.subtitle: Customize the Open in menu shown in the title bar and file previews.
openApps.commandPathHelp: Commands receive the selected path as the final argument.
openApps.macHelp: Apps open via `open -a` with optional args.
openApps.otherHelp: Apps run as an executable with optional args.

environments.title: Environments
environments.subtitle: Configure per-project setup scripts and worktree locations.

globalRoot.label: Global worktrees root
globalRoot.help: Default location for new worktrees when a project does not override it. Each project gets its own subfolder under this root.

setupScript.label: Setup script
setupScript.help: Runs once in a dedicated terminal after each new worktree is created.

projectRoot.label: Worktrees folder
projectRoot.help: Custom location for this project's worktrees. Leave empty to use the global root or the built-in default.

copyFailed.title: Copy failed
copyFailed.unavailable: Clipboard access is unavailable in this environment. Copy the script manually instead.
copyFailed.write: Could not write to the clipboard. Copy the script manually instead.

composer.title: Composer
composer.subtitle: Control helpers and formatting behavior inside the message editor.

followUp.title: Follow-up behavior
followUp.steerUnavailable: Steer is unavailable for the current model.
followUp.help: Choose the default while a run is active. Press {{shortcut}} to send the opposite behavior for one message.
followUp.unavailableHelp: Steer is unavailable for the current model. Follow-ups will queue.

presets.title: Presets
presets.subtitle: Choose a starting point and fine-tune the toggles below.
presets.label: Preset
presets.help: Presets update the toggles below. Customize any setting after selecting.

space.title: Expand fences on Space
space.subtitle: Typing ``` then Space inserts a fenced block.

enter.title: Expand fences on Enter
enter.subtitle: Use Enter to expand ``` lines when enabled.

languageTags.title: Support language tags
languageTags.subtitle: Allows ```lang + Space to include a language.

wrapSelection.title: Wrap selection in fences
wrapSelection.subtitle: Wraps selected text when creating a fence.

copyWithout.title: Copy blocks without fences
copyWithout.subtitle: When enabled, Copy is plain text. Hold {{key}} to include ``` fences.

multiline.title: Auto-wrap multi-line paste
multiline.subtitle: Wraps multi-line paste inside a fenced block.

codeLike.title: Auto-wrap code-like single lines
codeLike.subtitle: Wraps long single-line code snippets on paste.

continue.title: Continue lists on Shift+Enter
continue.subtitle: Continues numbered and bulleted lists when the line has content.

dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.subtitle: Enable microphone dictation with on-device transcription.

enable.title: Enable dictation
enable.subtitle: Downloads the selected Whisper model on first use.

language.label: Preferred dictation language
language.help: Auto-detect stays on; this nudges the decoder toward your preference.

holdKey.label: Hold-to-dictate key
holdKey.help: Hold the key to start dictation, release to stop and process.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.subtitle: Customize keyboard shortcuts for file actions, composer, panels, and navigation.
shortcuts.pressNewDefault: Press a new shortcut while focused. Default: {{shortcut}}

file.title: File
file.subtitle: Create agents and worktrees from the keyboard.

composer.title: Composer
composer.subtitle: Cycle between model and reasoning modes.

search.label: Search shortcuts
search.help: Filter by section name, action, or default shortcut.

git.title: Git
git.subtitle: Manage how diffs are loaded in the Git sidebar.

ignoreWhitespace.title: Ignore whitespace changes
ignoreWhitespace.subtitle: Hides whitespace-only changes in local and commit diffs.

commitPrompt.label: Commit message prompt
commitPrompt.helpBefore: Used when generating commit messages. Include

commitModel.help: The model used when generating commit messages. Leave on default to use the workspace model.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: App version, build metadata, and update controls.
